note: Roadway, Area, RoofFlood and RoofSpot are real manufacturer / test-lab LM-63 Type C files, copied byte for byte. repositoryLicence is the licence of the repository we took the file from; the files themselves carry no separate licence and are the manufacturer's published photometric data for lighting design. LowBeam, HighBeam and FogBeam are authored demonstration curves (Tools/AuthorLightingProfiles.py): no measured vehicle headlamp file under a permissive licence was found.

Roadway.shape: full cut-off roadway luminaire: peak 69° from nadir along the road (C0/C180), nothing above 80°

Area.usedFor: wide soft area light (profile slot 2: no light type uses it yet, available to custom lights)
Area.shape: rotationally symmetric; 50 % of peak at 60° from the axis, 12-19 % of peak above the horizontal

LowBeam.shape: authored demonstration curve (not measured); regenerates byte-identically from the script

HighBeam.shape: authored demonstration curve (not measured); regenerates byte-identically from the script

FogBeam.shape: authored demonstration curve (not measured); regenerates byte-identically from the script

RoofFlood.usedFor: roof flood pods (light type 5, flood variant)
RoofFlood.shape: rotationally symmetric flood (60° beam): 50 % of peak at 30° from the axis, nothing beyond 40°; measured to 90°

header.TEST: LightLab International Test Report No. LL20433-R01-S1
header.LUMINAIRE: Efficient Lighting Systems LED Display Track Light. Product ID: DT106.XTM10.N.94.61.

RoofSpot.usedFor: roof spot pods (light type 5, spot variant)
RoofSpot.shape: rotationally symmetric LED spot: 50 % of peak at 8° from the axis; measured to 90°

searched.method: GitHub REST code search (extension:ies, IESNA), then licence and header review of the candidates in permissively licensed repositories
searched.automotive: No measured vehicle headlamp / fog lamp LM-63 file under a permissive licence was found. The one candidate (fglichttechnik/Radiance-RoadLighting-Simulation-Framework RoadRad/examples/HeadLight.ies) is a 12 x 11 table of round numbers with no licence, not a measurement.
